title: File:ASC Leiden - van Achterberg Collection - 01 - 46 - Des maisons en argile avec des points comme décorations sur les coins du toit - Agadez, Niger, novembre 1990 - janvier 1991.tif
desc: Clay houses with points as decorations on the corners of the roof. Asphalt road past the house of the famous blacksmith Mohammed Ag Koumama. A hut of rags with a boy, a girl and barrels. A man on a bicycle, men with packages on the head. Electricity cables.

title: File:ASC Leiden - F. van der Kraaij Collection - 10 - 023 - Un garçon pose en plein air avec un âne et une charrette - Burkina Faso, 1981.tif
desc: A boy is posing in the open with a donkey and a two-wheel donkey cart under a tree. He is putting a coin against his teeth. Two other donkeys and carts, a boy near a bicycle. A mud brick wall, covered market stands with branches as poles. In the distance an oblong white building.
